title: ULA scenarios.yaml — clean-room test scenarios for one unit

unit.description: Unit slug (the unit this block covers).

scenarios.description: Test-case scenarios, generated clean-room (without reading existing tests), excluding behavior tied to a bug in bugs.yaml.

id.description: Slug from the scenario's essence, unique within the unit.

description.description: Implementation-agnostic: precondition/input -> expected outcome, what to stub/assert. Enough for another agent to write the unit test.

coverage-intent.description: The specific code paths/branches/conditions/statements this scenario is meant to exercise. The prompt requires at least one entry; an empty list is structurally tolerated so a single unmapped scenario cannot fail the whole unit's result.

target.description: Semantic description of the specific thing covered. No line numbers.
